title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1982-05-21
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:96330) SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD; CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC and Audience (shnid:109334) (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/Maxell XLII-S90); Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a high‑energy 1982 show with standout Playin' > Uncle John’s Band, The Wheel and Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as a solid “sick” performance, highlighted by the seamless Playin' → Uncle John's Band segue, a powerful Wheel, and an engaging Black Peter segment. Dave Usborne’s matrix mix delivers crystal‑clear fidelity that lets the band’s energy shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings, emphasizing strong musical moments and superb recording fidelity; weighting show quality (70%) and recording quality (30%) results in a high average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the fidelity is a joy, praising Dave Usborne’s mix for its clarity, balance, and overall superb sound quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow with strong segues, especially the Playin' into UJB transition and cohesive mid‑set segments.
